record.paper_title: Open problems in dynamics and related fields
record.context_brief: Global rigidity of higher-rank semisimple actions
record.original_question: Is every action of a connected semisimple Lie group whose simple factors all have real rank at least 2, or of a lattice in such a group, that contains an element acting nontrivially and uniformly partially hyperbolically C^∞-conjugate to an algebraic action?

evidence.quote: CONJECTURE 5. Every action of a connected semisimple Lie group of higher ra nk (i.e., all simple factors have real rank at least 2) or a lattice in it that has an element which acts non-trivially uniformly partially hyperbolically, is C∞ -conjugate to an algebraic action.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G be a connected semisimple real Lie group all of whose simple factors have real rank at least 2, and let Γ be either G itself or a lattice in G. Suppose Γ acts smoothly (by C^∞ diffeomorphisms) on a closed smooth manifold M, and suppose that there exists an element γ ∈ Γ whose action on M is nontrivial and uniformly partially hyperbolic (i.e., the tangent bundle TM admits a continuous Dγ-invariant splitting TM = E^s ⊕ E^c ⊕ E^u into stable, central, and unstable subbundles, with uniform exponential contraction on E^s, uniform exponential expansion on E^u, and intermediate behavior on E^c, and with at least one of E^s, E^u nontrivial).

An algebraic action is one of the following standard models: (a) a left translation action of Γ on a double coset space K\H/Λ, where H is a Lie group containing Γ, Λ ⊂ H is a cocompact lattice, and K ⊂ H is a compact subgroup commuting with Γ; (b) an affine action on a compact nilmanifold N/Λ induced by an embedding of Γ into the affine group of N; or combinations and finite covers thereof.

Question: Must every such action of Γ be C^∞-conjugate to an algebraic action? That is, does there exist a C^∞ diffeomorphism h from M to the underlying manifold of an algebraic Γ-action that intertwines the two actions?
artifact.category_tag: Smooth rigidity of higher-rank group actions
artifact.status_search_result: The global smooth rigidity conjecture for higher-rank semisimple Lie group and lattice actions with a uniformly partially hyperbolic element is a central open problem in the Katok–Spatzier rigidity program. Substantial partial progress has been made (local rigidity under weak hyperbolicity, global rigidity under dominated-splitting or Anosov assumptions, cocycle rigidity for abelian higher-rank partially hyperbolic algebraic actions), and counterexamples are known for some weaker/related formulations, but the conjecture in the stated generality remains unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Anatole Katok's work on cohomology and geometric rigidity (Spatzier)
status_evidence.snippet: The Katok-Spatzier rigidity program... classify 'irreducible' partially hyperbolic Z^k- and R^k-actions.
status_evidence.claim: The global rigidity conjecture is stated as an outstanding goal of the program, with only partial results.

status_evidence.title: Global rigidity of higher rank lattice actions with dominated splitting
status_evidence.snippet: Global rigidity proved under dominated-splitting hypotheses.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress under stronger hyperbolicity hypotheses.

status_evidence.title: Instability for rank one factors of product actions
status_evidence.claim: Some related formulations admit counterexamples, showing the conjecture is delicate.
